On Fri, Oct 3, 2008 at 2:10 PM, Venkat <vese...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> I am trying to extract this info. I have downloaded the necessary
> files but I get the following error:
>
> > cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6",
> tags="Full")
> > ufl <- AromaUflFile$fromChipType(getChipType(cdf))
> Error: attempt to apply non-function

Use byChipType() instead of fromChipType(). I'm moving away from the
latter in favor of the former (same functions different names). Newer
classes only has byChipType(). Similarly for byName() and fromName().
Thus,

cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6", tags="Full");
ufl <- AromaUflFile$byChipType(getChipType(cdf));

FYI, I've updated the online pages to use byChipType() and byName().
If you spot a page using from*(), please let me know.

>
> (I am trying to get the probe-sets queried by Sty I & Nsp I and
> following the steps in http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/genomewidesnp-6?version=22)

Ok, v22 of that page is old, so be careful; better to read the latest version.

Hope the above help

Henrik

I see. For now, you can access the UFL data using
ufl[units,fragments], e.g. ufl[units,2], which returns a data frame.
The rows are indices as units in a CDF (as always in
aroma.affymetrix). There is a developers page on UFL files giving a
hint on this usage:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/unit-fragment-length-ufl-files

The UGP and UFL formats/APIs are still "under development", which is
why I don't announce them more.

Henrik
